name: NYC REACH Members
description: This dataset lists members of NYC REACH, a health information technology program, with 2,376 sampled records and nine columns. Each row describes a participating provider or practice, including the provider's first and last name, practice name, primary specialty, site name, organization type, and practice location details such as borough, mailing address, and ZIP code. The data can be used to map the geographic distribution of participating providers across New York City boroughs, analyze the mix of specialties and organization types in the network, identify practices by location for outreach or referral, and support research on health IT adoption and primary care capacity.
